purpose: Check whether the Quimpo et al. (2019) fish assemblage study and its supplementary list support site- or location-resolved species records for the Batanes/Luzon Strait survey.

source.title: Similarity in benthic habitat and fish assemblages in the upper mesophotic and shallow water reefs in the West Philippine Sea
source.provider: Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom; Cambridge University Press
source.publication: Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom, 99(7), 1507–1517 (2019)
source.citation: Quimpo, T. J. R., Cabaitan, P. C., Go, K. T. B., Dumalagan, E. E. Jr., Villanoy, C., & Siringan, F. P. (2019). Similarity in benthic habitat and fish assemblages in the upper mesophotic and shallow water reefs in the West Philippine Sea. Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom, 99(7), 1507–1517. https://doi.org/10.1017/S0025315419000456

geographicLocations: Luzon Strait (identified by the article as the Batanes islands)
studyScope.LuzonStraitSites: Three shallow-water reef sites and three upper-mesophotic sites; the article does not give a verified station-name or coordinate table in the reviewed material.
studyScope.depths: Shallow-water reefs: 8–22 m. Upper mesophotic coral ecosystems: 30–40 m.
studyScope.fishSurvey: Modified fish visual census on 25 m transects with a 10 m belt; divers recorded fish taxa, counts, and estimated total length.
studyScope.fieldPeriod: Not established in the inspected article sections; do not assign a year or date to individual survey records from the 2019 publication date.

supplementReview.retrieval: Publisher-hosted supplement fetched successfully (18,310 bytes) and inspected in memory; no local raw copy retained.
supplementReview.tableTitle: Electronic Supplementary Material 1. List of coral genera and fish species in the South China Sea based on Gomez et al. (1994), Nañola et al. (2006, 2010), Huang et al. (2015), and Licuanan et al. (2017).
supplementReview.localityResolution: There is one presence/absence column and no separate columns for Luzon Strait/Batanes, Palawan, or KIG. A check mark indicates presence in the pooled set of upper-mesophotic study locations; it cannot identify which location or station supplied that detection.
supplementReview.unmarkedInterpretation: An unmarked literature-list taxon is not evidence of absence from Batanes, the wider WPS, or shallow-water reefs.

articleFindings.namedLuzonStraitAssociation: The article states that biomass-weighted assemblages for Luzon Strait and some KIG sites were associated with Acanthurus pyroferus. This is a multivariate assemblage association, not a station-level record, count, or exact capture location.
articleFindings.otherTaxa: Other taxa are named in associations with Palawan or KIG, but these pooled or statistical associations are not converted to independent site occurrences in this review.

rightsAndLimits: Cambridge metadata displays copyright © Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom 2019; no item-specific open license for the article or supplementary table was verified.
The supplement was inspected for structure and aggregate location resolution, but its name table was not copied into the repository or projected to Bangwit.
Do not assign the pooled 80 marked taxa to Batanes. The research locations include Batanes/Luzon Strait, Palawan, and KIG, while the supplement lacks a location crosswalk.
The article is a historical reef survey and does not establish current presence, complete provincial diversity, catchability, diet, fishing rules, conservation status, or safety guidance.
The named Acanthurus pyroferus association remains research-only and does not provide a station-specific occurrence or abundance record.
nextAction: Keep this article as a research-only regional marine source. Seek a location-resolved fish-by-site matrix or original field dataset before adding any Batanes species records; continue separate freshwater and estuarine coverage.
